name: Traveler (Anemo)
notes: KQM has no Anemo Traveler guide (its quick-guide address for this character answers 404), so this card rests on Game8 (Anemo Sub DPS build) and genshin-builds.com (checked 2026-10-30), which agree on 4pc Viridescent Venerer, Skill > Burst > Normal Attack, an Anemo DMG Goblet and a CRIT or EM Circlet. They differ on the Sands (Game8: Energy Recharge; genshin-builds: EM, ATK% or ER; ER and EM are both kept), and on the first weapon (Game8: Primordial Jade Cutter; genshin-builds: Freedom-Sworn, which is a second pick here). Palm Vortex (Skill) is the damage line (Initial Storm DMG 176% to 317%, elemental curve). Neither source gives numeric goals, so none is set; the app fills them from the role. Partners are the elements Viridescent Venerer shreds. Sources are thin, so confidence is medium, not high.
